description: This file defines the PdfObjectID struct, which represents a unique identifier for a PDF object, consisting of an object number and a generation number. It includes constructors, properties, equality operators, and utility methods for managing PDF object IDs within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PdfObjectID
classes.description: A struct that uniquely identifies a PDF object using an object number and a generation number.

methods.name: PdfObjectID
methods.description: Constructor initializing object and generation numbers with validation and logging.

methods.name: UniqueNumber
methods.description: Calculates a 64-bit unique number combining object and generation numbers.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Indicates if the object ID is empty (object number is zero).

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with another PdfObjectID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object ID.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Implements IComparable to compare two PdfObjectID instances.
